title: OpenAI发布GPT-6Astra:行业迈入AGI时代，性能多维跃升并重塑安全边界
content:
On September 3, OpenAI officially launched its latest cutting-edge large model, GPT-6Astra, which it characterizes as a "generation leap" in fields such as software engineering, professional work, science, and cybersecurity. Greg Brockman, President of OpenAI, clearly stated at the press conference that the release of Astra marks the industry's entry into the "General Artificial Intelligence (AGI) era."
Previously, the internal version of this model successfully solved ten long-standing problems in the fields of mathematics and theoretical computer science, and made significant breakthroughs in agent coding and cybersecurity capabilities, becoming the first OpenAI model to reach the "critical" cybersecurity capability threshold in its "preparedness framework."
In terms of technical performance and benchmark testing, Astra achieved a disruptive improvement compared to previous generations and similar models. In the ARC-AGI-3 test, Astra scored an impressive 98.6%, far exceeding GPT-5.6Sol (7.8%) and Claude Opus5 (30.2%); it scored 97.6% in FrontierMath Tier4(v2), significantly leading other large models; and it led in several tests including GPQA Diamond (96%), DeepSWE v1.1 (74.1%), Terminal-Bench Science0.1 (64.6%), Agents' Last Exam (59.3%), and AutomationBench (41.4%).
Additionally, the security protection system has been significantly enhanced. The model not only comes with new monitoring functions to prevent unauthorized operations but can also more reliably reject harmful network requests.
Currently, GPT-6Astra is available to enterprise cybersecurity customers who have gained access through the OpenAI Daybreak program, with its core security features still limited to trusted defenders. Over the next few days, it will be gradually released to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise subscribers. In terms of pricing, Astra is set at $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens, matching the price of Anthropic's Claude Fable5.1. As an important milestone in commercialization and technological evolution, Astra's commercial deployment not only marks an increase in the threshold for advanced AI agent deployment but also opens up a new landscape of competition for large models with high computing power and high security barriers.

report.summary: OpenAI发布GPT-6Astra，宣称进入AGI时代，性能与安全双突破。
report.background: OpenAI于9月3日推出新一代大模型GPT-6Astra，被定位为软件工程、科学及网络安全领域的跨代产品。此前内部版本已解决数学和计算机科学领域十个长期难题，并在智能体编码与网络安全能力上达到“关键”阈值。模型在多项基准测试中远超GPT-5.6Sol、Claude Opus5等竞品，ARC-AGI-3得分高达98.6%。同时安全系统显著增强，可拒绝有害请求并监控未授权操作。商业化已启动，先面向企业安全客户，随后向ChatGPT订阅用户开放，定价对标Claude Fable5.1。
key_points: GPT-6Astra在ARC-AGI-3测试得分98.6%，远超GPT-5.6Sol的7.8%和Claude Opus5的30.2%，性能代差明显。
模型在FrontierMath、GPQA Diamond等多项科学和编程基准中领先，并解决十个长期未解数学问题，体现强推理能力。
安全方面首次达到OpenAI“准备框架”中的“关键”网络防御阈值，具备防止未授权操作和拒绝有害请求的新功能。
率先通过Daybreak计划向企业网络安全客户开放，未来几天将逐步覆盖ChatGPT Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise用户。
定价每百万输入token 10美元、输出token 50美元，与Anthropic Claude Fable5.1一致，抬高高端模型竞争门槛。
report.impact: 对AI行业而言，Astra的发布将AGI竞赛推向新阶段，迫使其他厂商在算力和安全投入上加码；对开发者来说，更强的智能体编码能力可大幅提升自动化效率，但部署成本与安全合规要求同步升高；对普通用户，实际影响取决于产品接入速度，早期可见更智能的助手和复杂任务处理能力，同时需警惕安全边界扩大带来的监管讨论。总体看，Astra标志着高性能与高安全双壁垒的行业新常态。
report.tools: 可关注OpenAI Daybreak计划及ChatGPT接口；安全研究者可参考OpenAI Preparedness Framework文档。开发者可尝试ARC-AGI基准与FrontierMath题库评估模型能力，或追踪Anthropic Claude Fable系列对标动态。
